about_the_game:
🌟 What You Can Play in the Demo​

Full Chapter Experience​

  • The complete first chapter, "Desert Prisoner" (2-3 hours of gameplay), featuring 2 unique scenarios:​

▶ Scorching Desert: Sandstorms reduce visibility and slow movement, with multiple choices to make as you explore;​

▶ Ancient Ruins: Dimly lit environments filled with dangers lurking in the shadows—stay alert to survive.​

2 Unique Boss Fights (Hardcore Combat)​

  • 4 weapon types are fully available, each with distinct features:​

▶ Different combat mechanics await your experience and feedback.​

Content Not Yet Available (In Development)​

  • The following features are not included in this demo and will be added later:​

  • Passive ability system​

  • Execution system​

📢 We Value Your Feedback (It Shapes Development!)​

After playing, please help us answer 3 simple questions:​

  • Among the 4 weapon types, which one feels the most comfortable / uncomfortable to use?​

  • Did you encounter any "frustratingly difficult" moments while fighting bosses (moments that made you want to give up)?​

  • What effects would you like to see in the passive ability system?​

We welcome your feedback! Join our Discord to discuss further:​

Discord：

This content is intended to serve the game's plot atmosphere and gameplay design, without excessive exaggeration or graphic portrayal.
2、Sexual Content: The game does not contain any sexual content, sexual imagery, or related suggestive elements throughout, adhering to a healthy content orientation.
3、Other Sensitive Content: The game does not include any depictions of or gameplay involving drugs or alcohol, nor does it contain content that encourages or depicts self-harm behavior, ensuring no negative guidance for players.
